_about: One table of the level cut-offs for every service that reads theta: diagnostic-service (tests/test_e7_level_thresholds.py), auth-service (diagnostic_level.py), front (diagnostic-level.ts). Plain data: copy the file or read it as is. Status codes: critical < -1.4 <= below < -0.5 <= partial_gap < 0.1 <= on_level < 1.0 <= above. Category: below_grade < -0.5 <= at_grade < 1.0 <= above_grade.

not_level_thresholds._about: Cut-offs of the CAT task pool in session_service, NOT of the student's level: below the first one the pool also takes tasks of the previous grade, below the second - of two grades back (floor: grade 5). The second (-1.5) is deliberately not the 'critical' cut-off (-1.4): it is a different decision (which tasks to serve), made on the running estimate.
